name: notes
description: CRUD for .md notes in memory/notes/. Supports line-level editing, timestamps, and find/replace.
payload_hint: content, line numbers, or find/replace query

list: list all note filenames with created/modified dates
append: content to add to the end of the note
delete: line/range (optional, deletes whole file if omitted)
search: keyword (returns matching lines and line numbers)
